title: Unrefined Minimal K Type Correspondence
body_html:
Unrefined Minimal K Type Correspondence

If two epipelagic representations correspond under theta, then there exists a residual vector \(\bar w\) in the quotient \[ B_{-1/(2m)}/B_{-1/(2m)+} \] such that the source functional and target functional are obtained from \(\bar w\) by the two residual moment maps, with the target sign convention of the paper.
proof_html:
Extraction

The proof applies Pan's minimal \(K\)-type result to the oscillator representation, producing building points \(y,y'\) and a vector \(w\) whose moment maps give the unrefined minimal \(K\)-types of the two representations. Epipelagic data equivalence then conjugates \(y,y'\) back to \(x,x'\), leaving the residual moment-map condition.
